verifications.claim: Rec Room is shutting down on June 1, 2026, at noon Pacific Time.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the platform will go fully dark at noon Pacific Time on June 1'; R2: 'Rec Room will be closing down on June 1st 2026 at noon Pacific time'; R5: 'The platform will go dark at noon Pacific on June 1'; R6: 'Rec Room will shut down June 1, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the exact date, year, and time of shutdown.

verifications.claim: The developer announced the shutdown due to profitability issues and an unsustainable business model.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'could not find a path to profitability'; R2: 'never quite figured out how to make Rec Room a sustainably profitable business. Our costs always ended up overwhelming the revenue'; similar phrasing across all sources
verifications.reasoning: All sources quote the official statement directly attributing shutdown to profitability and unsustainable model.

verifications.claim: Rec Room has over 150 million users.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'drew more than 150 million players'; R2: 'reaching over 150 million players and creators'; identical across sources
verifications.reasoning: Every source explicitly states over/more than 150 million users/players.

verifications.claim: New account creation was blocked immediately following the announcement.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Rec Room immediately blocked account creation'; R2: 'as of this update... You can no longer create new accounts'; R5: 'Starting immediately, Rec Room is blocking new account creation'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state immediate blocking of new account creation.

verifications.claim: New friend requests were blocked immediately following the announcement.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'immediately blocked... friend requests'; R2: 'You can no longer add someone as a friend'; R5: 'blocking... new friend requests'
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation of immediate block on friend requests.

verifications.claim: New Rec Room Plus subscriptions were blocked immediately following the announcement.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'new subscriptions to its Rec Room Plus membership'; R2: 'You can no longer sign up for Rec Room+ (RR+)'; R5: 'new subscriptions to its Rec Room Plus membership'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated as immediate block on new RR+ subscriptions.
